execution.scheduler_quota_adaptation: The account rejects a 32-element array because its submission cap is 20. Submit positions 1-16 first and positions 17-32 through a scheduled dependency controller; both arrays retain concurrency 4, and the finalizer accounts for all 32 positions.

method.change_from_rejected_route: Replace the earlier full v1.1 output contract with the already-frozen D43 three-object compact contract, without changing construct definitions or silently repairing model semantics.

method.reference: Existing accepted candidate outputs with their original model-assisted provenance; never described as human gold labels.
method.analysis: Use frozen field-level export, retain unknown/error as null, report model-reference agreement with actual comparable denominators and transport/schema/quote failures separately.
method.production_gate: Root reviews actual completed output and material concept errors against the frozen operational policy. Schema validity or hardware success alone does not authorize bulk inference. No automatic full-corpus dependency job.

operations.transport: Existing model/runtime and minimum necessary inputs transferred between cloud endpoints; Mac is SSH transport/control only, with no retained raw-data copy.
operations.jobs: Separate scheduled preparation, dependent inference array, and after-any diagnostic finalization; actual scheduler IDs and states recorded in submission receipts.
operations.failure: Preserve raw partial output and exit status; do not label incomplete or token-capped output completed merely because a file exists.
operations.stop: Stop HIP build attempts. Do not silently route CPU-only inference onto a DCU-billed partition.
